The '''31st [[Golden Globe Awards]]''', honoring the best in [[film]] and [[television]] for 1973, were held on January 26, 1974.

[[George Roy Hill]]'s ''[[The Sting]]'', which in April 1974 would win seven [[46th Academy Awards|Academy Awards]] including [[Academy Award for Best Picture|Best Picture]] and [[Academy Award for Best Director|Best Director]], generated a Golden Globe nomination only for [[Golden Globe Award for Best Screenplay|Best Screenplay]].
